RATHORE HAVELI · GRAND ENTRANCE COLONNADE

ARCHITECTURAL & FORENSIC OBSERVATIONS:
• Grand Symmetrical Staircase: 300-year-old Rajput-Mughal carved timber with worn crimson ceremonial runner.
• Wall Decay & Lime Mortar: Peeling teal lime plaster reveals the underlying 18th-century masonry and the sealed eastern corridor partition.
• High Arched Windows: Rain from the July 1998 monsoon streaks across the glass. Every clock in the adjacent corridor stopped at exactly 02:13 AM.
• Paranormal Anomaly: The 13th bell tolled in this hall despite only twelve bells hanging in the courtyard arcade.
